_description: Qwen3.8 27B — local ninfer-serve deployment for agentic tool-calling workloads. Successor to qwen36; the default local executor in UAP routing. Routes through the anthropic-proxy for the tool/finalize guardrails, NOT the inference server directly.
_engine: ninfer-serve (NOT llama.cpp). Observed flags: --max-context 131072 --kv-capacity 131072 --max-concurrency 1 --max-pending-requests 16 --prefill-chunk 1024 --kv-dtype int8 --spec mtp --draft-tokens 3 --lm-head-draft. It speaks the OpenAI API and emits native tool_calls, so the proxy needs no format shim, but it is NOT llama.cpp and does not serve /props, /metrics or /slots.
_max_tokens_comment: Deliberately generous against a 131072 window. This engine returns chain-of-thought in a SEPARATE reasoning_content field, so reasoning spends completion budget without ever appearing in content. A tight cap therefore does not produce a short answer, it produces an EMPTY one with finish_reason=length — measured previously as ~90% first-turn decode failure that read as bad output format and was really budget truncation.
_sampling_comment: Carried over from qwen36 unchanged: these are UAP's tool-call-tuned values, not the vendor's chat defaults, and nothing has been re-measured on 3.8 yet. Re-tune with `uap tune` before changing them.
_thinking_comment: Top-level only. This engine REJECTS chat_template_kwargs outright (HTTP 400 chat_template_option_not_supported) — that key is a llama.cpp --jinja concept and qwen36.json carries it for that reason. The proxy probes the backend once and drops the nested form when it is refused (PROXY_CHAT_TEMPLATE_KWARGS=auto|on|off).

dynamic_temperature._comment: On retry, temp = max(floor, base_temp * decay^attempt). Reduces randomness for structured output.

tool_call_batching.system_prompt_suffix: When multiple tools are needed, call ALL of them in a single response. Do not call one tool and wait - emit all tool calls together.
tool_call_batching._comment: Reduces round-trips by encouraging multi-tool emission in one turn.

concurrency._comment: The server runs --max-concurrency 1 with --max-pending-requests 16: a second request QUEUES, it does not run alongside. Anything that fans out local calls is buying latency, not throughput, so the model-slot lease must treat this as a single rail. Unlike the qwen36 llama.cpp setup there are no --parallel slots and the window is NOT divided.

speculative_decoding._comment: Multi-token-prediction self-speculation built into the engine (--spec mtp --draft-tokens 3 --lm-head-draft). No draft model, no separate weights.

server_optimization._comment: These are the flags the server is actually running under, recorded so a rebuild reproduces the measured behaviour.

measured._comment: 3 reps direct to the inference server (76.3/78.8/78.3 tok/s) and 3 through the proxy (77.6/81.8/81.7), greedy, 512-token cap. The proxy adds no measurable overhead — the two sets overlap within run-to-run noise.

routing._comment: Route through the anthropic-proxy, NOT the inference server directly — the proxy applies the tool/finalize guardrails and advertises the context window that clients size their history to.
